scope: read-only audit bulgularinin production guvenligi ve DB emniyeti icin duzeltilmesi

findings.title: Startup TRUNCATE removal
findings.before: await client.query('TRUNCATE TABLE data_observations, source_payloads').catch(() => undefined);
findings.after: query removed; only SET lock_timeout and pg_advisory_lock remain before migration loop
findings.securityImpact: Her deploy/restart'ta observability/provenance tablolarinin silinmesi durduruldu; migration idempotency ve advisory lock korundu
findings.migrationBehavior: schema_migrations dongusu, BEGIN/COMMIT ve error handling degismedi; 020 migration yalnizca bir kez calisir

findings.title: Unauthenticated destructive endpoint hardening
findings.before: GET+POST /api/db-cleanup ve GET /api/db-diagnostics auth olmadan acik
findings.after: GET /api/db-cleanup kaldirildi; POST /api/db-cleanup ve GET /api/db-diagnostics production'da ADMIN_API_TOKEN/x-admin-token guard arkasinda, aksi halde 404
findings.securityImpact: Anonim destructive GET kaldirildi; production'da token yoksa endpointler tamamen devre disi
findings.productionCleanupEndpointBehavior: GET yok; POST yalnizca dogru x-admin-token ile; anonymous 404 ve repository.dbCleanup cagrilmiyor

findings.title: Nowgoal remote JavaScript execution removal
findings.after: zod schema validation + deterministic parseNowgoalFixtureDiary array-literal parser; no eval/new Function/vm
findings.securityImpact: Remote provider Data alani artik kod olarak calistirilamaz; RCE primitifi kaldirildi
findings.parserBehavior: Yalnizca A[i]=[...] / B[i]=[...] array literalleri okunur; diger ifadeler yok sayilir; gecersiz payload NO_DATA/PARSE_ERROR ile [] doner, crash yok, sahte odds yok

findings.title: pg_terminate_backend removal
findings.before: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND datname = current_database()
findings.after: query removed; migration serialization only via pg_advisory_lock
findings.securityImpact: Web/worker/health/backfill ve diger servis baglantilari startup'ta sonlandirilmiyor
